policy.least_work_scope: optimizer routing only while work_delegation_gate is logically disabled; authoritative O revision 24 forbids applying revision-23 least-Work policy to primary O
policy.candidate_identity: source-qualified stable identity; never join audits/comparisons by bare short candidate id alone
policy.decision_dimensions: novelty, evidence strength, and decision relevance remain separate fields even when produced by one comparator run
policy.control_freshness: pin note main at run start; read sanitized DESIRED_STATE and this DOWNSTREAM_STATE at the same SHA; before substantive work recheck note main and refetch if control_revision or this role's config_revision changed; after semantic work begins freeze selected config and record source SHA/blob
policy.bridge_freshness: bridge pins feed to observed note main SHA, rechecks head before mutation, refetches on head advance/revision regression, and never regresses tracked feed revision

o_feed_backlog_control.rule: Before new admission while O clean cursor lags, compare candidate against all unacknowledged feed items by source-qualified identity, mechanism, decision question, tested scope and uncertainty. Admit only material incremental decision information. Supersede/replace better/newer representations of same item while retaining provenance/supersession chain. Semantically deduplicate equivalent items; never drop distinct decision-relevant items for arbitrary count cap.
o_feed_backlog_control.receipt_requirement: emit all metrics on every integrator run, even when no admission occurs, so backlog policy observability is continuous

downstream_wave_protocol.seal_rule: If no incomplete active wave exists, seal one source-qualified artifact/blob per clean namespace from latest valid role-local pointer/checkpoint; keep incomplete wave immutable.
downstream_wave_protocol.consumer_rule: novelty/relevance and evidence comparators evaluate exact ACTIVE_WAVE and carry wave_id, manifest blob and source_set_digest; no moving-latest substitution.
downstream_wave_protocol.integration_rule: integrator accepts only exact matching triplet, reconciles, readbacks, marks integrated, then seals next wave.
downstream_wave_protocol.independence_rule: ACTIVE_WAVE is downstream-only; clean explorers never read it.

primary_source_verifier.policy: verify high-value clean claims against primary sources with exact source-qualified scope and no worker steering; prefer active sealed wave/admitted feed where useful; after urgent feed candidates rotate across under-audited namespaces; separate unverified from contradicted

o_novelty_comparator.policy: Read exact ACTIVE_WAVE. In one O read-only pass produce separate novelty/status and decision relevance for same wave. Carry wave_id, manifest blob, source_set_digest, exact source blobs and O snapshot. Never use novelty as relevance proxy, write worker feedback, modify O, or replace sealed wave with newer worker output.

evidence_comparator.policy: Read exact ACTIVE_WAVE; assess primary quality, quantitative result, matched baseline, ablation, reproducibility and exact scope using source-matched corrections. Carry wave identity. Never write exploration judgments, attach by bare short id, or substitute newer worker artifacts.

integrator.policy: Sole ACTIVE_WAVE coordinator. Keep incomplete wave stable. Accept only exact matching novelty/evidence/relevance triplet. Canonicalize by source-qualified identity; preserve contradictions/scope/provenance/uncertainty. Apply backlog control before admission and emit the full backlog metric set on every run, including no-admission runs. After exact readback mark integrated then seal next wave. Sanitize worker feedback to self-local process/source defects only.

bridge.policy: bridge only clean O_FEED at safe O boundary; no extra Work solely for polling; no individual item spam; preserve exact revision/digest/blob acknowledgement; fresh O owner suppresses recovery/duplicate writing; do not import work_delegation_gate policy into primary O; obey bridge freshness handshake and never regress tracked feed revision

work_delegation_gate.logical_disable_reason: No current separate gate-owned execution source; authoritative O revision 24 forbids exporting this policy into primary O. Keep disabled unless concrete separate gate queue/source appears.
work_delegation_gate.policy: LOGICALLY DISABLED. If later re-enabled, route only separate gate-owned work to reasoning/tools/APIs/automations/repository before Work; read O only for collision/safety checks.

automation_optimizer.policy: optimize repository-defined managed config from actual execution evidence; read all receipts/control files; sole aggregate-ledger reconciler; never self-disable; distinguish logical from physical scheduler state; preserve authoritative targeting; detect stale control reads, wave races, feed backlog, contamination and recovery quality. Keep DESIRED_STATE sanitized for clean explorers and store substantive non-clean policy only in DOWNSTREAM_STATE/O_OPERATIONS.
